main_axis.headline: Your momentum comes from backing your own view and staying engaged with peers.
main_axis.body: The lead force is Companion—your own judgment and peers who move with you. Rob Wealth—competition among peers and scrambling for resources—adds pressure to contest choices and negotiate who contributes; Eating God—craft and enjoyment that flow naturally—and Hurting Officer—the urge to speak out and challenge rules—show a smaller route into making or questioning things. This chart does not follow the regular framework; the engine withholds favorable-element conclusions.

core_loop.headline: You turn peer discussion into something said or made, then use the response to decide again.
core_loop.flow: Companion—your own judgment and peers who move with you—sets the direction, while Rob Wealth—competition among peers and scrambling for resources—keeps the group focused on who decides and contributes. Eating God—craft and enjoyment that flow naturally—and Hurting Officer—the urge to speak out and challenge rules—give that activity a way to become something made or said; the response then feeds your next judgment.

core_loop.leak:
You can spend effort rechecking who agrees and what position to hold, while a finished product or stable return remains outside the discussion.
The ten years starting around age 49 (the 戊午 pillar) bring fire and earth into the timing, so the balance of expression and practical demands can shift. This is an observation, not a favorable-element conclusion.
For now, end each group discussion with one deliverable and one person responsible, and reopen the decision only when new information changes it.

structure_type.name: the self-directed, peer-coordinating type
structure_type.one_line: You begin with your own view, work it through with peers, and express it by making or challenging ideas.

capability_source.headline: Strongest when a group must choose a direction and you can state your case; weakest when you must maintain fixed procedures without room to question the method.
capability_source.text: Your strongest scene comes from the weight carried by your own judgment and peer exchange. In a planning meeting where colleagues disagree about the next step, you can state your view and keep the group engaged in deciding what to do.

structure_fingerprint: You form direction through your judgment and peer exchange, express it in words or work, and do not automatically turn expression into wealth or formal standing.
